question: total number of regions and top 5 products which are higky returnable
sql:
SELECT p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS return_count
FROM returns r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY return_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
final_result: [('Fully-configurable needs-based toolset', 6), ('Function-based regional neural-net', 5), ('Diverse asynchronous service-desk', 5), ('Mandatory discrete data-warehouse', 5), ('Right-sized impactful benchmark', 5)]
